content: Drospirenone has the potential to increase the plasma levels or pharmacological effects of various drugs by influencing the metabolism mediated by the hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. The clinical significance of these interactions is generally considered minor or unknown. Below are the detailed interactions: 1. Ombitasvir/Paritaprevir/Ritonavir: Drospirenone may elevate the levels or effects of this combination therapy by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. 2. Dasabuvir (DSC): Drospirenone may increase the levels or effects of dasabuvir through CYP3A4 modulation. 3. Omeprazole: Drospirenone may enhance the levels or effects of omeprazole by affecting CYP3A4 activity. 4. Ondansetron: Drospirenone may increase the levels or effects of ondansetron via CYP3A4 metabolism. 5. Paclitaxel: Drospirenone may elevate the levels or effects of paclitaxel by altering CYP3A4 activity. 10. Paclitaxel Protein-Bound: Drospirenone may enhance the levels or effects of protein-bound paclitaxel through CYP3A4 metabolism. 11.
